messages:
Nadia: deploy-bot flagged a CI promotion hold: our lockfile lease service is returning RESOURCE_BUSY on cache-lease acquire for artifact-store. tagging @Infra-Alex — this is blocking the 02:00 UTC change window.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Promote 9456 HOLD: cache-lease.acquire_failed (RESOURCE_BUSY) for key=ci/cache/locks/service-auth-2026-03-24. Retries exhausted across runners {staging-4, staging-5}.

Kai: I've seen RESOURCE_BUSY when the lease coordinator had a stuck goroutine; can we check coordinator metrics and whether there's an active lease holder?

Infra-Alex: Looking now. coordinator shows many long-held leases from 03:10 -> 03:30 UTC, owner="ci-batch-connector" on node builder-21. There are also >50 lease refresh failures.

QA-Mino: The promote depends on cache-lease for safe cache rehydration. If we bypass the lease check we risk concurrent writes and corrupting artifacts. What's the risk appetite to skip?

Product-Rosa: PMs want the cut to ship today; the change includes a billing fix. But we prefer not to risk artifact corruption. Can we pin or delay?

Nadia: Two unblock options: 1) wait for Infra to kill the stuck lease and re-run promote (time uncertain), 2) pin promote to previous build that passed preflight (v2026-03-23-rc4), 3) emergency bypass: run promote with --force-cache-write which skips lease acquire (risky). Thoughts?

Infra-Alex: I can force-evict leases from builder-21 and restart the coordinator service — should take ~5-7 minutes. That seems reasonable and keeps us on latest build.

Kai: Evict + restart is safer than bypass. If you evict, please capture the stacktrace of the stuck goroutine and snapshot the executor state for postmortem.

QA-Mino: If we restart, we should re-run the full smoke (not just quick check) because cache state could be funky for a short time. That adds ~10m.

Nadia: We have a 20-minute window. Evict+restart+full smoke fits. If Infra can't complete in 20m, fallback to pin v2026-03-23-rc4. I'll coordinate.

Infra-Alex: Starting eviction on builder-21 now. Evicting 3 leases. capturing stacks -> saved to /tmp/lease-stacks/evict-3101112222.log. Restarting coordinator.

deploy-bot: [SYSTEM] Coordinator restart detected. Queueing promote retry in 30s.

Kai: Good. Also enabling extra logging on lease refresh path for the next hour.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Promote retry FAILED: cache-lease.acquire_failed (timeout). runners observed short S3 read spikes during cache rehydrate.

Nadia: Hm. Did the restart not clear the underlying builder-21 worker? Alex, any lingering processes?

Infra-Alex: There was a zombie uploader process on builder-21 holding file descriptors open. I killed it and cleared the lock files. Retrying promote now.

deploy-bot: [AUTO] Promote retry PASSED smoke. promote completed.

Product-Rosa: Thanks team. Please add a release notes entry: "Promotion briefly paused due to cache lease coordinator issue; evicted stuck leases and completed promote. No consumer impact observed."

Nadia: Filed INC-2026-099: "cache-lease coordinator goroutine stuck, caused RESOURCE_BUSY on lease acquire" with links to stack dumps and builder-21 snapshot. Postmortem scheduled tomorrow.

QA-Mino: We'll monitor artifact verification metrics for next 24h.

Nadia: Cut successful. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
